passages.locator: Artificial silk and nylon in Coventry
passages.note: The Science Museum dates the Courtaulds artificial-silk factory in Coventry to 1905 and describes the British Nylon Spinners factory producing nylon yarn in Britain in 1941. Viscose rayon is regenerated cellulose, distinct from synthetic nylon.
